content.short: Nuvola is the first DePIN aggregator on Cardano, providing rewards from multiple infrastructure projects.
content.description: Nuvola is an innovative protocol that serves as the first DePIN (Decentralized Physical Infrastructure Network) aggregator within the Cardano ecosystem. By staking the native $NVL token, users gain diversified exposure to rewards from various infrastructure projects like World Mobile and Minutes Network without managing hardware. Nuvola strengthens decentralized networks by operating its own robust node infrastructure and offering sustainable reward mechanisms for token holders. The platform prioritizes ease of use and capital efficiency for participants in the growing DePIN sector.
